answer: Require every agent to lock a stake of jade-backed collateral before it can trade, and record each trade on a shared marble ledger that any peer can audit. A new identity starts with a whisper of reputation and must earn trust through small, verifiable jobs before larger ones unlock. Creating many fake identities multiplies the locked stake and the audit trail, so a Sybil attacker pays a real, rising cost for each extra identity while honest agents pay once.
